title: Blur In
description: Words arrive out of focus and sharpen one after another, like eyes adjusting.
usage: For the one sentence a page opens with. The script splits the element’s words into spans and staggers their sharpening; run it once, on load or on scroll into view — a headline that re-blurs on every visit is a jump scare. Pairs well with restraint everywhere else.
a11y: The words are all in the DOM from the start, in order — screen readers read the sentence, not the stagger. Under prefers-reduced-motion nothing blurs: the words simply stand there, which is what they were doing anyway.
